info.title: CF Agent Hub — Proposed Native HTTP API
info.description: Pre-implementation design baseline dated 2026-10-23; contract revision 0.1. All operations are proposed and require implementation verification. No running service, SDK, protocol certification or exactly-once external execution is claimed. docs/http-api.md defines authorization, pagination, idempotency and concurrency semantics. docs/limits.md owns numerical operational limits. All JSON writes reject unknown fields and enforce UTF-8 envelope limits. Runtime-bound writes additionally require X-Runtime-Token proof; native bearer alone is insufficient. R1 amendment r1-foundation-1 specifies identity, settings, audit and protected recovery contracts; implementation remains pending. Portable contracts stay 0.1; deployment is 0.2.

post.summary: Atomically claim ready task, enforce current grant, assignment, work-role eligibility and WIP, create active run and larger task-local fence
post.description: Atomically claim ready task, enforce current grant, assignment, work-role eligibility and WIP, create active run and larger task-local fence. Credential must bind the runtime agent; runtime must be live. Native bearer AND X-Runtime-Token must validate to the same credential/agent/workspace; proof runtime must match the request or stored run. IDs and fence are not authentication. Reject outcome_unknown and retry_exhausted holds. There is no hold-clear or retry-budget extension command in this baseline; reconciled reviewed replacement work is required. Atomically persist trusted retry-safety policy classification with the claim/audit before execution. On expiry default to backlog+outcome_unknown; only preexisting replay-safe classification permits bounded automatic retry. Stale runtime cannot mutate or assert safety after losing authority.

post.description: Require active run ownership and fence; mark run failed, release lease. Retry budget permitting: increment retry_count and ready, otherwise backlog with retry_exhausted. outcome_unknown requires reconciliation before another external attempt. Native bearer AND X-Runtime-Token must validate to the same credential/agent/workspace; proof runtime must match the request or stored run. IDs and fence are not authentication. If outcome_unknown=true, always move to backlog with outcome_unknown and do not schedule another run, regardless of retry budget. This route cannot report an expired/stale run: former owner must read/escalate. Expiry scheduling conservatively holds outcome_unknown unless trusted replay-safe policy was persisted at claim.

NativeBearer.description: Agent principal only. Never authenticates a human or authorizes human-only commands. Grant scopes use x-required-scopes; OAuth is not implied.

HumanSession.name: cfhub_session
HumanSession.description: Verified human Access/OIDC session mapped to issuer+subject and current workspace membership. Same-origin and CSRF validation required for writes. Cookie name is a proposed contract, not an implemented login flow.

RuntimeProof.name: X-Runtime-Token
RuntimeProof.description: Opaque one-time-issued runtime proof; server verifies hash bound to workspace, agent, runtime and issuing native credential. Required together with NativeBearer, never an alternative. Not an ID or fence. Revoked/expired credentials and expired runtime invalidate it. Re-enroll after credential rotation.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Unique command key scoped by workspace, authenticated principal and operation+target. Preserve unchanged for retries. See docs/limits.md for retention.

CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfToken.description: Required on cookie-authenticated writes. Must match the same-origin human session. Not a substitute for authentication.

Artifact.description: Metadata state is separate from object bytes. Only committed same-workspace artifacts may enter task results, checkpoints or messages. expires_at is the upload deadline for staged/uploaded and null once committed.
